// @dndgen/core: generated by `make doc` from the package's declarations. Do not edit.

// ===== packages/core/src/assemble.ts

import { type AssembleOptions, type CampaignSource } from "./campaign.ts";
import { type AdventureMeta } from "./frontmatter.ts";
export interface AssembleResult {
    /** The whole campaign as one Adventure Markdown document. */
    markdown: string;
    meta: AdventureMeta;
    /** Campaign-relative paths of the images the document uses, all of which exist. */
    assets: string[];
    /** Problems worth telling the author about: missing images, broken links. */
    warnings: string[];
}
/**
 * Turns a lorewright campaign into a single Adventure Markdown document: front matter,
 * then the introduction, the chapters and the appendices in book order, with cross-file
 * links pointing at ids inside the one document and lorewright's conventions (read-aloud
 * blockquotes, stat blocks, sidebars, art embeds) turned into explicit blocks.
 */
export declare function assemble(source: CampaignSource, options?: AssembleOptions): AssembleResult;

// ===== packages/core/src/campaign.ts

/**
 * A lorewright campaign as plain data: no file system, so the same code runs in Node and
 * in a Worker.
 */
export interface CampaignSource {
    /** Markdown files, keyed by campaign-relative path with forward slashes. */
    documents: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
    /** Campaign-relative paths of every other file, such as the art picks. */
    assets: ReadonlySet<string>;
}
export interface AssembleOptions {
    /** Add references/*.md as appendices. Off by default. */
    includeReferences?: boolean;
    /** Add chapters-summary.md, which repeats the overview, as an appendix. Off by default. */
    includeSummary?: boolean;
    /** Theme written to the front matter. Defaults to dndbeyond. */
    theme?: string;
}
export type DocumentRole = "introduction" | "chapter" | "appendix" | "briefing";
export interface CampaignDocument {
    path: string;
    /** Prefix for the heading ids of this document; also the id of its title. */
    key: string;
    role: DocumentRole;
    text: string;
}
export declare const OVERVIEW = "campaign-overview.md";
/** True when the files look like a lorewright campaign rather than an assembled adventure. */
export declare function isCampaign(paths: Iterable<string>): boolean;
/** Picks the documents that go into the book and puts them in book order. */
export declare function planDocuments(source: CampaignSource, options?: AssembleOptions): CampaignDocument[];
/** Resolves a link target relative to the document it appears in. */
export declare function resolvePath(from: string, target: string): string;

// ===== packages/core/src/frontmatter.ts

export type GameSystem = "5e" | "daggerheart";
/** The YAML header of an Adventure Markdown document. */
export interface AdventureMeta {
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    system: GameSystem;
    theme: string;
    /** Campaign-relative path of the cover image. */
    cover?: string;
    /** Print a table of contents after the cover. Defaults to true. */
    toc?: boolean;
}
export declare function splitFrontMatter(source: string): {
    data: Record<string, unknown>;
    body: string;
};
/** Reads the header of an Adventure Markdown document, filling in defaults. */
export declare function parseAdventure(source: string): {
    meta: AdventureMeta;
    body: string;
};
export declare function formatFrontMatter(meta: AdventureMeta): string;

// ===== packages/core/src/index.ts

export { type AssembleResult, assemble } from "./assemble.ts";
export { type AssembleOptions, type CampaignDocument, type CampaignSource, type DocumentRole, isCampaign, planDocuments, } from "./campaign.ts";
export { type AdventureMeta, type GameSystem, parseAdventure } from "./frontmatter.ts";
export type { HeadingInfo } from "./markdown.ts";
export { adventureAssets } from "./references.ts";
export { CONTENTS_ID, type RenderOptions, type RenderResult, renderHtml } from "./render.ts";
export { footerPlan, matchOutline, type OutlineEntry, renderPageSheets } from "./sheets.ts";
export { slug } from "./slug.ts";

// ===== packages/core/src/markdown.ts

export interface HeadingInfo {
    id: string;
    depth: number;
    text: string;
    /** Inside a stat block, a figure or another box; such headings stay out of the contents. */
    boxed: boolean;
}
export declare function escapeHtml(text: string): string;
/**
 * Parses Adventure Markdown to HTML and reports the headings it saw, with their ids, in
 * document order. A heading takes its id from a trailing `{#id}`, or from its text.
 */
export declare function markdownToHtml(markdown: string): {
    html: string;
    headings: HeadingInfo[];
};

// ===== packages/core/src/references.ts

/**
 * Relative paths of the images an Adventure Markdown document uses: its cover and every
 * image embed. URLs with a scheme are left out; they are not part of the bundle.
 */
export declare function adventureAssets(markdown: string): string[];

// ===== packages/core/src/render.ts

import { type AdventureMeta } from "./frontmatter.ts";
import { type HeadingInfo } from "./markdown.ts";
export interface RenderOptions {
    /** URL that the document's relative image paths resolve against: the campaign root, ending in "/". */
    baseUrl: string;
    /** URL of the core package's assets/ directory (themes/ and vendor/), ending in "/". */
    assetUrl: string;
    /** Page numbers for the table of contents, by heading id. Omitted on a first pass. */
    pageNumbers?: ReadonlyMap<string, number>;
    /**
     * How the parchment and running footers get onto the pages: "css" draws them with @page
     * rules, which need Chrome 131 or later; "sheets" leaves them out, to be printed as
     * separate page sheets and laid underneath (see sheets.ts).
     */
    decoration?: "css" | "sheets";
}
export interface RenderResult {
    html: string;
    meta: AdventureMeta;
    /** Every heading in document order, as a browser's PDF outline will list them. */
    headings: HeadingInfo[];
}
/** Id of the table of contents heading. */
export declare const CONTENTS_ID = "contents";
/**
 * Renders an Adventure Markdown document as one HTML page meant to be printed by Chrome:
 * cover, table of contents, then one section per chapter (each top-level heading). The page
 * sets `data-ready` on <html> once fonts, images and diagrams are done.
 */
export declare function renderHtml(markdown: string, options: RenderOptions): RenderResult;
/** Appends a relative path to a directory URL. */
export declare function joinUrl(base: string, path: string): string;

// ===== packages/core/src/sheets.ts

import type { AdventureMeta } from "./frontmatter.ts";
import { type HeadingInfo } from "./markdown.ts";
/** One bookmark of a printed PDF, in document order. */
export interface OutlineEntry {
    title: string;
    /** 1-based page number. */
    page: number;
}
/**
 * Finds the page of every heading by walking the PDF's bookmarks alongside the headings
 * the renderer reported; both are in document order. Bookmarks that match no heading are
 * skipped, so a heading Chrome left out only costs that heading its number.
 */
export declare function matchOutline(headings: readonly HeadingInfo[], outline: readonly OutlineEntry[]): Map<string, number>;
/**
 * The running footer title of every page (index 0 = page 1), or null for pages without a
 * footer: the cover and table of contents, before the first chapter starts.
 */
export declare function footerPlan(headings: readonly HeadingInfo[], pages: ReadonlyMap<string, number>, pageCount: number): (string | null)[];
/**
 * The sheets laid under the printed pages: first the page background, shared by every page,
 * then one sheet per page with its running footer. Print it with a transparent background,
 * so the footer sheets carry nothing else.
 */
export declare function renderPageSheets(meta: AdventureMeta, plan: readonly (string | null)[], assetUrl: string): string;

// ===== packages/core/src/slug.ts

/**
 * Heading anchors the way GitHub generates them, which is the convention lorewright
 * campaigns use for their cross-links: lowercase, punctuation stripped, spaces to hyphens.
 */
export declare function slug(text: string): string;
/** Hands out unique slugs, suffixing repeats with -1, -2… like GitHub. */
export declare class Slugger {
    #private;
    next(text: string): string;
}
/** Plain text of an inline markdown string, for slugging headings that contain markup. */
export declare function plainText(markdown: string): string;
